stem: 以下哪两项陈述描述了公私合作伙伴关系(PPP)的优势？(选择两项.)

options.A: 公共组织能够更好地了解私营部门所经历的情况,并为政策制定和法律的制定提供信息.
options.B: 数据保护与隐私政策为制定信息共享协议提供了机会,以防止未经授权访问信息.
options.C: 数据保护隐私政策因基于政府旧有立法的限制而阻碍了PPP模式的演进
options.D: 小企业主可以选择第三方供应商或金融机构来保障其个人数据的安全,这些数据在公私合作伙伴关系中可以轻松共享.

stem_en: Which of the following statements describe the strengths associated with public-private partnerships (PPPs)? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Public organizations can better understand what the private sector experiences and inform policy and the enactment of laws.
options_en.B: Data-protection privacy policies provide an opportunity to develop information-sharing protocols to prevent unauthorized access to information.
options_en.C: Data-protection privacy policies prohibit the evolution of PPPs due to restrictions based on legacy government legislation.
options_en.D: Small business owners can choose third-party suppliers or financial institutions to safeguard their private data, which can be easily shared in public-private partnerships.
